import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().runProgram();
    }

    private void runProgram() {
        InputHandler input = new InputHandler(System.in);
        OutputHandler output = new OutputHandler(System.out);
        
        UnstoppableAlgorithm algo = new UnstoppableAlgorithm();
        algo.compute(input, output);
        
        output.close();
    }

    static class UnstoppableAlgorithm {
        void compute(InputHandler in, OutputHandler out) {
            int n = in.readInteger();
            long budget = in.readLong();
            int[] data = new int[n];
            int[] parity = new int[n];
            
            for (int idx = 0; idx < n; idx++) {
                data[idx] = in.readInteger();
                parity[idx] = (data[idx] & 1) == 0 ? 1 : -1;
            }

            List<Integer> validDifferences = new ArrayList<>();
            long cumulative = 0;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
                cumulative += parity[i];
                if (cumulative == 0) {
                    validDifferences.add(Math.abs(data[i] - data[i + 1]));
                }
            }

            Collections.sort(validDifferences);
            long spent = 0;
            int selectedCount = 0;
            
            for (int diff : validDifferences) {
                if ((spent += diff) <= budget) {
                    selectedCount++;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
            
            out.write(selectedCount);
        }
    }

    static class InputHandler {
        private final BufferedReader reader;
        private StringTokenizer tokens;

        public InputHandler(InputStream stream) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(stream));
        }

        private String nextToken() {
            try {
                while (tokens == null || !tokens.hasMoreTokens()) {
                    tokens = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
                }
                return tokens.nextToken();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
            }
        }

        int readInteger() {
            return Integer.parseInt(nextToken());
        }

        long readLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(nextToken());
        }
    }

    static class OutputHandler {
        private final PrintWriter writer;

        public OutputHandler(OutputStream stream) {
            writer = new PrintWriter(stream);
        }

        void write(int value) {
            writer.println(value);
        }

        void close() {
            writer.close();
        }
    }
}
